What We Do

One course, tailored to
whatever you're celebrating.

Weddings

A course dressed to match the day — florals, ribbon hoops and a castle hole worked in around your reception, so guests have something to do between speeches and dancing.

Events & Parties

Birthdays, anniversaries, festivals or a big back-garden get-together — we'll size the course to your space and keep every age group entertained for hours.

Corporate

A genuinely fun team activity that still feels premium — great for office parties, client days and team-building, indoors or out, with zero setup on your end.

Hand-Built, Not Off-The-Shelf

Every course is built,
not just set up.

Each hole is made and finished by hand — real timber, real turf, real detail. Nothing here is inflatable or off a shelf, which is why it looks right sitting on a hotel lawn beside a wedding tent.

Our course can be tailored to suit your venue — holes added or removed to fit the space you've got.
We deliver, set up and collect the whole course — you don't lift a finger.
Suitable indoors and outdoors, with the venue's permission.

From real weddings,
not stock photos.

The Brehon Hotel & Spa, Killarney
Meet the Craftsman

Hi, I'm Callum.

Every hole you see has been designed, built and finished by hand — with one goal in mind: creating a fun, memorable experience for your guests.

What started as an idea has grown into a premium mini golf hire service for weddings, corporate events and celebrations across Ireland.

Seeing people enjoy the course at our first wedding made every late night and every hour spent building it worthwhile.

— Callum, Founder
